title: Day 4 / 500 — ATS-Y1-004 Normalize Survey Project Intake Values
subtitle: Convert spreadsheet-style text into typed Java values for survey intake.

steps.title: Day 4.1 Verify Day 3 remote state
steps.why: Confirm the main-method launcher work is already present before adding intake normalization.

steps.title: Day 4.2 Create SurveyProjectIntakeParser
steps.why: Introduce a focused parser utility for spreadsheet-style survey input.

steps.title: Day 4.3 Convert estimated-record text into int
steps.why: Use Integer.parseInt because calculations require a primitive numeric value rather than spreadsheet text.

steps.title: Day 4.4 Narrow decimal completion percentage explicitly
steps.why: Use an explicit cast to convert a decimal completion percentage to the whole-number display required by the console summary.

steps.title: Day 4.5 Add shared static intake counter
steps.why: Track successful intake parses at class level so all calls share one count.

steps.title: Day 4.6 Convert record count back to String
steps.why: Use Integer.toString when the numeric count must return to a display/reporting representation.

steps.title: Day 4.7 Prove primitive int cannot store null
steps.why: Compile an intentionally invalid primitive-null assignment and preserve the compiler failure as learning evidence, not production code.

data.output: error: incompatible types: <null> cannot be converted to int

steps.title: Day 4.8 Integrate normalization into existing main()
steps.why: Extend the existing command-line flow so survey-import can normalize the second argument instead of leaving parser logic isolated.

data.content: \n// Day 4 integration: parse survey-import record count with SurveyProjectIntakeParser.\n

steps.title: Day 4.9 Compile, run, and inspect Java 8 bytecode
steps.why: Verify the normalized survey-import path executes and still compiles to Java 8 class-file version 52.

data.command: javac --release 8 -d out src/com/ats/geospatial/*.java; java -cp out com.ats.geospatial.GeospatialOperationsApplication survey-import 12500

steps.title: Day 4.10 Update coverage, push, and verify
